rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site aggregated datasets (HCP, OpenBHB, OASIS-3, Cam-CAN, and NCL site cohort) used for normative model
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: We utilised four public datasets of T1-weighted scans from healthy controls: the WU-Minn Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP); Open Big Healthy Brains (OpenBHB); Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS-3); and the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN). We also used a cohort of healthy adult participants scanned at Newcastle University as part of another study (site=NCL).
rci1_using_msad.location: bdi13484-sup-0001-supinfo.docx.md: 1 Normative model of cortical thickness
